_about: The sample data Sample_Data_Service seeds into an empty site. portal_enabled is the client-level portal switch only (it shows the Portal tab to staff); no contact is given portal access. Every value here is fictional: parody companies and film/TV characters (resource/seed_gags.txt is the chart), test email addresses (domain test.<company>.com, never delivered) and (nnn) 555-01nn phone numbers (never texted). Dates are day offsets from the day of seeding. Each documents[] entry is also the generator's input (resource/generate_documents.php): type pdf|docx|xlsx|png|jpg, with body paragraphs, or rows for xlsx, or lines for an image.
